Evidence: Arvind Kejriwal ne Sheila Dikshit par ilzaam lagaya hai ki unhone 2008 mein illegal colonies ko authorize kiya tha, jo political gain ke liye kiya gaya tha (Source 1). Congress ne Kejriwal ke dharne ko support nahi kiya, jisse unka isolation dikh raha hai (Source 2). Kejriwal ne kaha ki Sheila Dikshit ab important nahi hain, jo Congress ko criticize karne ka mauka diya (Source 3).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh pata chalta hai ki Arvind Kejriwal ne Sheila Dikshit par corruption ke ilzaam lagaye hain aur unki governance ko criticize kiya hai, jo claim ke core assertion ko support karta hai. Source 1 mein unka investigation ka demand aur Source 3 mein unka statement ki Sheila Dikshit ab important nahi hain, yeh sab is baat ko darshata hai ki Kejriwal Congress par vaar karne ke liye unhe target kar rahe hain. Isliye, evidence claim ko support karta hai.
